name: TARGETID
description: DESI unique target identifier

name: sample
description: Sample flag: "small" (10-15 kpc, 47 rows) or "large" (>25 kpc, 30 rows). Filter on this to separate the two samples

name: Name
description: VLASS radio component name
source: VLASS SE Continuum catalog (Kimball et al. 2026)

name: RA
description: Right ascension (J2000) of the radio source
source: VLASS SE Continuum catalog (Kimball et al. 2026)

name: DEC
description: Declination (J2000) of the radio source
source: VLASS SE Continuum catalog (Kimball et al. 2026)

name: Z
description: DESI spectroscopic redshift

name: Flux
description: VLASS 3 GHz total flux density
source: VLASS SE Continuum catalog (Kimball et al. 2026)

name: E_Flux
description: Uncertainty on Flux
source: VLASS SE Continuum catalog (Kimball et al. 2026)

name: LAS
description: Largest angular size of the radio source
source: VLASS SE Continuum catalog (Kimball et al. 2026)

name: Physical_Size
description: Projected linear size from LAS and redshift

name: Alpha
description: Catalog radio spectral index (S ~ nu^alpha), used to K-correct the 3 GHz luminosity. NOT used in the paper's jet power estimate, which converts 3 GHz to 151 MHz with a flat alpha = -0.7. Blank for 2 large sources; -0.7 assumed for those
source: VLASS SE Continuum catalog (Kimball et al. 2026)

name: E_Alpha
description: Uncertainty on Alpha
source: VLASS SE Continuum catalog (Kimball et al. 2026)

name: D_L
description: Luminosity distance

name: log_L_radio
description: log10 rest-frame 3 GHz radio luminosity, K-corrected as (1+z)^(-1-alpha)

name: w80
description: [OIII] 5007 W80 line width, two-Gaussian pyspeckit fit, instrumental resolution removed

name: bpt_class
description: BPT classification from the [OI]/Ha diagram: seyfert, liner, or sf

name: sl_distance
description: Perpendicular distance from the Seyfert/LINER line y = 1.18x + 1.30 in the [OI] BPT plane; positive = Seyfert side

name: NEV_3426_FLUX
description: [NeV] 3426 emission line flux

name: NEV_3426_FLUX_IVAR
description: Inverse variance of NEV_3426_FLUX. Blank where flux is 0.0 (line not fitted)

name: OI_6300_FLUX
description: [OI] 6300 emission line flux

name: OI_6300_FLUX_IVAR
description: Inverse variance of OI_6300_FLUX

name: OIII_5007_FLUX
description: [OIII] 5007 emission line flux

name: OIII_5007_FLUX_IVAR
description: Inverse variance of OIII_5007_FLUX

name: HALPHA_FLUX
description: Narrow H-alpha emission line flux

name: HALPHA_FLUX_IVAR
description: Inverse variance of HALPHA_FLUX

name: HBETA_FLUX
description: Narrow H-beta emission line flux

name: HBETA_FLUX_IVAR
description: Inverse variance of HBETA_FLUX

name: HALPHA_BROAD_FLUX
description: Broad H-alpha emission line flux. 0.0 where no broad component was fitted; nonzero identifies Type-1 AGN

name: HALPHA_BROAD_FLUX_IVAR
description: Inverse variance of HALPHA_BROAD_FLUX. Blank where flux is 0.0

name: fit_HB_FLUX
description: Fitted H-beta 4861 flux, narrow + broad components. The very broad (BLR) component is excluded

name: fit_OIII_5007_FLUX
description: Fitted [OIII] 5007 flux, narrow + broad components

name: fit_HA_FLUX
description: Fitted H-alpha 6563 flux, narrow + broad components. The very broad (BLR) component is excluded

name: fit_NII_6584_FLUX
description: Fitted [NII] 6584 flux, narrow + broad components. Kinematics tied to H-alpha, doublet ratio fixed at 1/3

name: fit_OI_6300_FLUX
description: Fitted [OI] 6300 flux, narrow + broad components. This is the flux behind the y-axis of paper Figure 4

name: log_oi_ha
description: log10(fit_OI_6300_FLUX / fit_HA_FLUX). x-axis of paper Figure 1

name: log_oiii_hb
description: log10(fit_OIII_5007_FLUX / fit_HB_FLUX). y-axis of paper Figure 1
